full_judgment: 56. It may be pointed out that Import Policy Order. 1989-91 was promulgated in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of Section 3 of the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, 1950. Any contravention of any order made or deemed to have been made under this Act or the Rules provides for legal action by the Chief Controller of Imports and Exports. In this case there is no such allegation at all. The law of Foreign Exchange Regulation Act, 1947 authorises the Bangladesh Bank to take legal actions for violation of Foreign Exchange Regulation. if there be any. In this case there is also no allegation of any violation as such. Thus. I hold that the learned Judges were correct in holding that the Customs Authority acted illegally and beyond the scope of the Customs Act.
